body:
**[comments] Rule 2, restates identifiers: shorten**

"32 dimensions = 16 dimension pairs" restates STEP_DIMS_32 = 32 and STEP_PAIRS_16 = STEP_DIMS_32 / PAIR_2 on the next two lines. The one fact the code does not say is why the step is 32: the depth of one AMX tile multiply.

Proposed:
```cpp
// One dimension step is the depth of one AMX tile multiply.
```
